title: GOOS ios not being respected
body:
### What happened?

Tried building with:

CONFIG

```yaml
  - main: ./cmd/ipsw
    id: ios
    binary: ipsw
    env:
      - CGO_ENABLED=1
      - CC=$GOROOT/misc/ios/clangwrap.sh
      - GOOS=ios
    goos:
      - ios
    goarch:
      - arm64
    mod_timestamp: "{{ .CommitTimestamp }}"
    flags:
      - -trimpath
    ldflags: -s -w -X github.com/blacktop/ipsw/cmd/ipsw/cmd.AppVersion={{.Version}} -X github.com/blacktop/ipsw/cmd/ipsw/cmd.AppBuildTime={{.Date}}
```

goreleaser cmd
```bash
GOROOT=$(shell go env GOROOT) goreleaser --debug build --id ios --rm-dist --snapshot --single-target --output dist/ipsw
````
